summary: Recovery week with gentle base-building rides and one moderate threshold effort. TSB is positive and fitness is stabilising, so we'll ease back in with mostly Z1–Z2 work.

days.description: Gentle spin to activate the legs after the weekend. Keep effort conversational; this is about getting the body moving without stress.

structure.label: Full ride
structure.notes: Easy gravel or road ride. Focus on smooth pedalling and relaxed effort. Heart rate should stay below 130 bpm.

days.description: Sustained low-intensity work to build aerobic base. Longer than Monday but still well within Z1–Z2; think 'steady conversation pace'.

structure.label: Warm-up
structure.notes: Easy spin to get settled in.

structure.label: Main ride
structure.notes: Steady cruising. Maintain effort around 110–125 bpm. Let the pace feel natural on terrain.

days.description: Full rest day. Recover well; no riding.
Moderate threshold work to maintain fitness. One solid effort block with recovery on either side. This is your only intensity session this week.

structure.label: Warm-up
structure.notes: Gradual build. Start easy and feel the legs warming up.

structure.label: Main set
structure.notes: 2 × 20 min at threshold effort (around 240 W), with 5 min easy (Z1) between. Aim for steady, controllable intensity.

days.description: Recovery ride after Thursday's effort. Keep it light and short; focus on clearing the legs rather than building fitness.

structure.label: Full ride
structure.notes: Relaxed gravel spin. Effort should feel effortless; HR around 110–125 bpm. This prepares for the weekend.

days.description: Your longest aerobic ride of the week. Steady, conversational pace building time on the bike and aerobic base.

structure.label: Main ride
structure.notes: Steady-state. Maintain around 115–130 bpm. On varied terrain (gravel preferred). Build time on the bike comfortably.

days.description: Full rest day. Preferred recovery day. No riding.
